name: Alpha-synuclein (UCB0599 / minzasolmin)

drugs.name: Minzasolmin (UCB0599)
drugs.source: ChEMBL canonical_smiles, molecule CHEMBL5095072 (synonyms incl. UCB0599, UCB-0599, DLX-313), retrieved 2026-10-30; max_phase 2 per ChEMBL

note: LOW-CONFIDENCE / ILLUSTRATIVE TARGET. Alpha-synuclein is intrinsically disordered: there is no stable drug pocket and no drug-bound high-resolution structure. The structure shown is chain A of 6A6B, a 3.07 A cryo-EM apo FIBRIL (residues 37-99 of 140; the rest is not resolved); it is not a ligand-bound state and not where UCB0599 acts. UCB0599 is described as an inhibitor of alpha-synuclein misfolding/oligomer formation, with no known binding site. pocket_residues is empty on purpose (none invented). Predicted binding affinities and any poses for this target are illustrative only. Sequence = full-length UniProt P37840 (140 aa), not the PDB construct.
